records.name: Dependency Architecture (Wave 6 Artifact 1)
records.description: Wave 6 detailed design (artifact 1) finalizing GPWCF dependency ownership and allowed/forbidden dependency directions across Core, optional Supporting Patterns, Prefect Integration, consumers, and the SMRB development environment, including the newly justified identity and diagnostics modules.

records.name: Dependency Ownership Principle
records.description: Dependency ownership follows semantic and operational responsibility, not repository proximity or current developer environment installation.

records.name: Core Runtime Standard-Library-Only
records.description: Core runtime imports remain standard-library-only in the current baseline; Core is installable and importable without Prefect, Generator dependencies, or SMRB development assets.

records.name: Prefect 3.9.2 Optional Runtime
records.description: Prefect 3.9.2 is an accepted optional external runtime owned only by integrations.prefect; installed only through the optional Prefect profile; never a Core dependency.

records.name: Optional Supporting Pattern Dependencies
records.description: Optional Supporting Patterns remain separately importable and are required only when selected by a concrete Step; consumers that do not select them incur no mandatory pattern package import.

records.name: Generator Extraction Dependencies
records.description: Generator extraction dependencies remain consumer-owned; GPWCF does not own or impose Generator-specific dependency closures.

records.name: SMRB .dependencies and Shared .env Treatment
records.description: SMRB .dependencies and shared .env remain the solution-level development dependency-management mechanism; GPWCF must not create a parallel local dependency bundle or environment; no GPWCF-local .dependencies directory is introduced.

records.name: Core Identities Module
records.description: core.identities is a narrow dependency-free module for nominal identity value types only; justified as part of Wave 6 dependency architecture.

records.name: Core Diagnostics Module
records.description: core.diagnostics is optional and does not become a universal Error Model; dependency closure analysis determines which contracts require diagnostics versus specialized error handling.

records.name: Minimal Prefect Integration Dependency Policy
records.description: Minimal Prefect Integration direct/transitive dependency policy; the 106-package environment snapshot is not treated as the minimal Integration dependency closure; minimal transitive lock remains a release gate.

records.name: Installation Profiles and Environment Isolation
records.description: Installation profiles and environment isolation guarantees ensure Core-only installation works without Prefect; build backend dependencies remain isolated from runtime dependencies.

records.name: Dependency Closure
records.description: Dependency closure and release gates: dependency graph is acyclic and all forbidden dependency directions remain prohibited; every runtime/build/development dependency has one explicit owner.

records.name: Single-Distribution Optional-Extra Packaging
records.description: Replaces unresolved distribution arrangement with one distribution and optional Prefect extra for the initial release; preserves the Core-only installation/import guarantee.

records.name: Setuptools Build Backend
records.description: Record setuptools==84.2.1 / setuptools.build_meta as isolated build-system dependency; build backend dependencies remain isolated from runtime dependencies.

records.name: Prefect Transitive Lock Release Gate
records.description: The exact Prefect transitive lock and clean isolated build verification remain explicit release gates; Prefect 3.9.2 preserved as optional runtime extra.

records.name: Dependency Graph Acyclicity
records.description: Dependency graph is acyclic and all forbidden dependency directions remain prohibited across Core, optional Supporting Patterns, Prefect Integration, consumers, and SMRB development environment.

records.name: Public API Readiness Gaps Resolved by Waves 1-4
records.description: Update Public API readiness gaps resolved by Waves 1-4 while retaining production integration/failure qualification gates; exact public import/export names detailed in 16.00_Public_API_Architecture.json.

records.name: Dependency Owner and Module Lists
records.description: Update dependency owner/module lists and dependency graph with core.identities and core.diagnostics; records required reconciliation changes to Dependency_and_Public_API_Architecture.json, Framework_Module_Boundary_Model.json, and Filesystem_Architecture.json.

records.name: Wave 6 Implementation Gate
records.description: Do not create pyproject.toml or install new project build dependencies until all Wave 6 artifacts and governing-artifact reconciliation are accepted; next step: design 15,00_Packaging.json.

records.name: Dependency Graph Nodes and Edges
records.description: Models dependency ownership and allowed/forbidden dependency directions across Core, optional Supporting Patterns, Prefect Integration, consumers, and SMRB development environment as a directed acyclic graph.
